name: financial-statements
description: Lets Claude answer questions on approved income statement exports, every figure cited to its cell.
long_description: Reads the approved Excel exports listed in approved.json in one folder. Five read tools, no write tool, no path or SQL input. Blocks an export that fails its checks (changed file, missing reporting unit, totals that do not tie, control totals that do not match). Ships with a synthetic demonstration folder; choose your own exports folder in the settings.

exports_folder.title: Approved exports folder
exports_folder.description: The folder holding approved.json and the exports it lists. Leave empty to use the synthetic demonstration data.

tools.name: list_snapshots
tools.description: Approved exports, their status and failed checks

tools.name: get_values
tools.description: Printed values with their cell references

tools.name: compare_periods
tools.description: Two snapshots side by side, with the change and its input cells

tools.name: margin_bridge
tools.description: Gross margin change split into rate and mix effects

tools.name: get_report_comments
tools.description: Comments written into an approved report
